terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you (the business using Pesa) and Pesa, developed by Björn Van Rensburg (we, us). Please read them. By registering a business or using Pesa you accept them, and you confirm that you may accept them for your business.

items: Pesa is business software for shops. It runs on your own computers and devices, and stores your records there. If you switch on the Advanced Pesa Connection, your records are also kept in your own online project that you create and control
Some features need an internet connection, for example cloud sync, password reset emails and loading the PDF engine for the first time
Pesa records and controls card sales but does not process card payments or connect to a bank. You take card payments on your own card machine
Every new business gets a free trial of 14 days from the day it is registered, with every feature open and no payment details needed
When the trial ends you need a licence to carry on. Nothing is deleted when a trial ends. You can still make a backup of your records
We give you a non exclusive, non transferable right to use Pesa for one business, for the period and plan on your licence key
A licence key is tied to your business's Licence reference. You may not share your key with another business, resell or rent Pesa, copy it for others, or remove or work around the licence checks
Your employees may use Pesa for your business, within the limits of your plan
The plans, what each includes, and their prices are shown on our price list or told to you when you subscribe. Prices are in Namibian dollars unless we say otherwise
You pay in advance for the period you choose, by electronic transfer or mobile wallet. We send your licence key after we confirm your payment
We may change prices. A change never affects a period you have already paid for, and we will tell you before it applies to your next renewal

sections.h: 5. Renewal and what happens when a licence ends
items: Nothing renews by itself and we do not keep your payment details. To carry on, you renew and we send a new key
Pesa warns you before your licence ends. After it ends there is a short grace period of 7 days, then Pesa locks until you renew
While locked your records stay where they are and the owner can still download a backup. Renewing opens Pesa again with everything as you left it
Your business records belong to you. We cannot see them, open them or recover them, as explained in the confidentiality and privacy agreement
You are responsible for backing up your data. Because it is stored on your own devices first, losing a device, clearing the browser data, or uninstalling the app can erase it if there is no backup
Cloud sync is not a backup. A wrong change on one device is copied to the others
Keep your records accurate and use Pesa lawfully

Tax and other filings are your responsibility. VAT figures and reports in Pesa are working figures built from what you record. They are not tax, accounting or legal advice, so check them with NamRA or your accountant
Keep passwords, PINs, sync codes and licence keys private, and decide carefully who in your business gets each role
You are responsible for handling your customers' personal details lawfully and with care
Do not use Pesa for anything unlawful, to harm others, or to try to break, overload or get around the app or its licence checks
Do not copy, change or reverse engineer Pesa except where the law allows it
We give support by WhatsApp and email. We work to answer quickly and fix faults, but we do not promise a fixed response time unless we agree one with you in writing
We release updates to fix faults, improve security and add features. Keep Pesa up to date. We may change or retire a feature, and we will tell you in advance when the change is large
We own Pesa, its code, design, name and logo. You own your data
If you send us ideas or feedback, we may use them to improve Pesa without paying you

sections.h: 11. No guarantee, and limits on our responsibility
items: We take care to make Pesa reliable, but it is provided as it is. We do not promise that it will be error free, always available, or fit for a particular purpose
As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, loss of business or loss of data, including loss that happens because there was no backup
As far as the law allows, our total responsibility to you for any claim is limited to what you paid us in the 3 months before the claim
Nothing in these terms limits a responsibility that the law does not allow us to limit
You can stop at any time by not renewing. There is no cancellation fee. Your licence works until the end of the period you paid for
We may suspend or end a licence if you break these terms, use Pesa unlawfully, share a key, or a payment is reversed or found to be fraudulent. We will tell you why where we can
Refunds are explained in the refunds and cancellation terms
We may update these terms. When we do, Pesa shows the new version and asks you to accept it. If you do not accept, you can stop using Pesa and make a backup of your records
These terms are governed by the laws of Namibia, and the Namibian courts may hear any dispute. We will first try to settle any problem with you in good faith
Questions about these terms: ecrypted5@gmail.com or WhatsApp 0818211692

refunds.title: Refunds and cancellation
refunds.intro: We want you to be sure before you pay, so every new business starts with a free 14 day trial. This page explains how cancelling and refunds work once you subscribe.

items: You can cancel at any time by simply not renewing. Nothing renews by itself and there is no cancellation fee
Your licence keeps working until the end of the period you paid for. After that Pesa locks, your records are kept, and you can still download a backup
A payment made twice or by mistake is refunded in full
If a fault stops Pesa from working and we cannot fix it within 14 days of you telling us about it, we refund the unused full months of your current period
We also refund whenever the law requires it

Once a licence key has been issued, payments for a period that has started are not refunded because you changed your mind, stopped using Pesa, or did not use all of the period. This is why the free trial exists
We do not refund a licence that was ended because these terms were broken
You can move to a bigger plan at any time. You pay the difference for the rest of your period and we send a new key
A move to a smaller plan starts at your next renewal

sections.h: 5. How to ask for a refund
items: Send your Licence reference, the date of the payment, your proof of payment and a short note of what went wrong, by WhatsApp to 0818211692 or by email to ecrypted5@gmail.com
We answer within 5 working days. Approved refunds are paid back to the account or wallet that paid, within 10 working days

items: WhatsApp 0818211692

items: Your business name and Licence reference (Menu, Licence and subscription)
What you were doing and what happened instead. A screenshot helps
The kind of computer or device you use and whether it was online
Try Search help in the menu, and the Training lessons
